description: This file contains test functions for the TensorFlow Go API, specifically testing the creation, behavior, and properties of Operation objects within TensorFlow graphs. It includes tests for operation lifetime, output list size, shape attributes, data types, shape validation, inputs, consumers, and device assignment.

methods.name: createGraphAndOp
methods.description: Creates a TensorFlow Operation within a new graph, returning the operation and potential error.

methods.name: TestOperationLifetime
methods.description: Tests that an Operation is not garbage collected while still in use, verifying its name and type.

methods.name: TestOperationOutputListSize
methods.description: Tests the OutputListSize and NumOutputs methods for a custom op with multiple outputs.

methods.name: TestOperationShapeAttribute
methods.description: Tests adding a Placeholder operation with shape attributes, verifying attribute settings.

methods.name: TestOutputDataTypeAndShape
methods.description: Verifies the data types and shapes of constants created with various data values, including unknown shapes.

methods.name: TestOperationInputs
methods.description: Checks the number of inputs for an addition operation between two placeholders.

methods.name: TestOperationConsumers
methods.description: Verifies that consumers of a tensor are correctly registered, including the producer operation.

methods.name: TestOperationDevice
methods.description: Confirms the device specification for an operation, such as GPU placement.

methods.name: forceGC
methods.description: Forces garbage collection to ensure proper cleanup during tests.
